title: Aunt Rose Won't Sit Down
subject: an aunt who dances through an entire wedding reception
caption: Afro house with a sung pop topline. Rolling log drum and conga polyrhythm carrying the groove, offbeat sub-bass, long slow-filtered pad builds, shakers panned wide, a single dry rim click marking the bar. Warm female lead with a chanted group answer, call and response, light saturation on the stack. 122 BPM, A minor. Warm, relentless, celebratory without being triumphant. No trap hats, no EDM riser, no supersaw, no drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - log drum and shakers, no vocal]

[Chorus - lead with group answer]
Aunt Rose won't sit down
Aunt Rose won't sit down
Folding chair been empty since the first song
Aunt Rose won't sit down

[Verse 1]
Rented hall on Culpepper, carpet smells like every wedding
Cousin's husband's brother running the laptop, one earbud in
The uncles took the corner where the cold air comes through
Somebody's child asleep under the gift table

[Chorus - lead with group answer]
Aunt Rose won't sit down
Aunt Rose won't sit down
Folding chair been empty since they cut the cake
Aunt Rose won't sit down

[Instrumental Break - congas and filtered pads]

[Verse 2]
She buried two husbands and a brother in this dress
Hem taken up twice, you can see the old stitch
Don't ask her about her knees
Ask her what year she learned this step

[Outro - log drum, voices fading]
Aunt Rose won't sit down
